clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau explains the partial fast: 500 to 1,200 calories a day, under 20 grams of protein, depending on your body size.

Stay under that protein line and your body keeps breaking down old, damaged cells for fuel - the process called autophagy. Go over it, he says, and that cellular cleanup stops.

It's the rule most people doing a "modified fast" never hear, because they're counting calories and ignoring protein entirely.

Are you tracking the number that actually matters?
